name: Futagami Kodama
source: A guest character from "[url=/v28562]Tomodachi Kara Koibito e[/url]." She works as a producer for the video game company "Nozarashi Soft," and is also a niece of [url=/c151233]Anju[/url]. Always folding her arms to look dignified, her passion for creating video games is stronger than anyone. She is approaching her thirties.
